propositions: sign_review permanently fails to persist attestations when unrelated tickets commit to the shared tracker during the sign attempt, leaving tickets unclaimable despite passing plan review
the sign fence compares store-wide tracker HEAD across collect() instead of the subject's own generation, demanding unachievable 5-7s global quiescence while inter-commit median is 3s
locked_head != expected_after comparison at generation.py:359 fires whenever lock acquisition blocks after a HEAD-moving commit, anti-correlated by construction
tracker_head_sha misclassifies another writer's staged index entries (normal add→commit locked footprint) as store-read-failure, consuming the bounded 3-attempt budget

the regression test monkeypatches tracker_head_sha to a constant, freezing out the store-wide fence from test coverage and proving only the identity scoping, leaving the under-lock and collect-window comparisons untested

fix requires scoping the fence to the subject's own immutable generation computed by collect(), deleting store-wide HEAD comparisons, promoting under-lock re-collect as the sole authoritative check, and tolerating peer staged entries in relation_snapshot
